parsed.doc_summary: Law-firm alert (Aug 21, 2026) on algorithmic rent-pricing laws. In-scope: SF §37.10C, San Diego §§98.1101-98.1104, Berkeley ch. 13.63 (effective Jan 2026 per this alert; conflicts with ordinance text date), Santa Ana NS-3090, Jersey City §218-12, Hoboken ch. 158.

rules.title: SF ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use qualifying algorithmic devices that use nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy. Tenants can sue for damages, injunctive relief and civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, with each unit-month a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span: The ordinance prohibits landlords from using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy.
rules.effective_date_note: Alert says effective October 2024; no day given.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data; up to $1,000 per violation
rules.penalty: Up to $1,000 per violation; each month per affected unit may be a separate violation

rules.title: San Diego ban on algorithmic rent-setting
rules.requirement: San Diego prohibits use of algorithmic rent-pricing tools like those in SF. Tenants may sue for damages, injunctive relief and penalties up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and rental property potentially a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span: San Diego similarly authorizes tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation.
rules.effective_date_note: Alert says effective June 2025; no day given.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data; up to $1,000 per violation

rules.title: Berkeley ban on coordinated pricing algorithms
rules.requirement: Berkeley prohibits coordinated rent-pricing algorithms. Each unit-month may be a separate violation, and private remedies are available.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies, previously at issue in RealPage, Inc. v. City of Berkeley et al.
rules.effective_date_note: This alert gives January 2026; the ordinance text reportedly says March 1, 2026. RealPage's challenge was voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Jan. 14, 2026.
rules.conflict_note: Two published effective dates: January 2026 (this law-firm alert) vs March 1, 2026 (ordinance text). Prefer the official ordinance text.

rules.title: Santa Ana ban on automated rent price-fixing
rules.requirement: Santa Ana prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing. Tenants can sue for up to $1,000 per violation per month.
rules.quoted_span: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.key_value: ban on automated rent price-fixing; up to $1,000 per violation per month
rules.penalty: Up to $1,000 per violation and per month

rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic rent coordination services. Enforcement is public and private, with fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.effective_date_note: Alert says effective June 2025; no day given.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic rent coordination; fines up to $2,000 per day

rules.title: Hoboken ban on algorithmic rent coordination
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms or occupancy.
rules.citation: Hoboken City Code ch. 158, Art. II
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.effective_date_note: Alert says effective July 2025; no day given.
rules.key_value: ban on software/algorithms/data-sharing platforms to coordinate rents
